## Objective
Make every health cutoff timezone-aware in UTC. Today all 24h windows use naive local datetime.now() against UTC-coerced records, so every window skews off UTC+0.

## Design summary
Convention is pre-decided: datetime.now(timezone.utc) - or the repo's existing tz helper if one exists (check first) - at all six cited sites, with comparisons tz-aware end to end. Defect sites: memento/health.py:724, :884, :1402, :1472, :1559, :1963. Line numbers are from the 2026-07-02 audit against main; after mem-124/mem-125 land on your branch, locate by content (naive datetime.now() in cutoff computation), not line number - and fix ALL naive-now cutoff sites found, which must be at least these six.

## File scope
Include: memento/health.py, new/updated tests under tests/.
Exclude: everything else; any cutoff outside health.py is out of scope.

## Constraints
No git push or PR creation - local branch/diff only. Use .venv/bin/python for every command. Work test-first: failing test that pins TZ to a non-UTC zone (e.g. Pacific/Kiritimati) and asserts a record 23h old is inside the 24h window, then fix all sites. If ambiguous, pause and ask.

## Verification
From the repo root:
1. .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/ (new TZ-pinned window test green; suite green)
2. .venv/bin/python -m ruff check .
3. .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check .
4. .venv/bin/python -m compileall -q memento hooks scripts
